record.paper_title: Open Problems in K-Stability of Fano Varieties
record.context_brief: Structure of minimizers for symplectic singularities
record.original_question: Let x in X be a symplectic singularity. Is the normalized-volume minimizer always a Kollár component E? If so, must its log discrepancy satisfy A_X(E) = r n for r equal to 1 or 2? After taking the extraction Y -> X of E and the index-one cover of that divisor, does the residue of the pulled-back symplectic form define an orbifold contact structure on E with contact line bundle O_Y(-rE)|_E? Finally, is the resulting log Fano pair underlying E always K-polystable, so that every symplectic singularity admits a Kollár component that is a contact Fano variety in the orbifold sense?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $x \in X$ be a symplectic singularity of dimension $2n$; that is, $X$ is a normal complex algebraic variety with a holomorphic symplectic form $\omega_X$ on its smooth locus that extends to a regular (possibly degenerate) $2$-form on every resolution of singularities. For a klt singularity $x \in X$, the normalized volume function $\widehat{\mathrm{vol}}_{x,X}$ is defined on the space of real valuations of $K(X)$ centered at $x$ by $\widehat{\mathrm{vol}}_{x,X}(v) = A_X(v)^{\dim X} \cdot \mathrm{vol}(v)$, where $A_X(v)$ is the log discrepancy of $v$. A Kollár component $E$ over $x \in X$ is a prime divisor $E \subset Y$ on a proper birational model $\pi : Y \to X$ such that $-E$ is $\pi$-ample, $\pi$ is an isomorphism over $X \setminus \{x\}$, $\pi(E) = \{x\}$, and $(Y, E)$ is plt. Establish the following conjectures:

(1) The normalized-volume minimizer of $\widehat{\mathrm{vol}}_{x,X}$ is realized (up to rescaling) by the divisorial valuation $\mathrm{ord}_E$ associated with some Kollár component $E$.

(2) For this Kollár component one has $A_X(E) = r n$ with $r \in \{1, 2\}$.

(3) Let $\pi : Y \to X$ extract $E$ as a Kollár component, and let $\widetilde{Y} \to Y$ be the index-one cover of $E \subset Y$ producing $\widetilde{E} \subset \widetilde{Y}$. Then the pullback $\pi^*(\omega_X)$ lies in $H^0(\widetilde{Y}, \Omega^2_{\widetilde{Y}}(\log \widetilde{E})(-r\widetilde{E}))$, and its Poincaré residue $\theta = \partial(\pi^*\omega_X) \in H^0(\widetilde{E}, \Omega^1_{\widetilde{E}} \otimes \mathcal{O}_{\widetilde{Y}}(-r\widetilde{E})|_{\widetilde{E}})$ defines an orbifold contact structure on $\widetilde{E}$ with contact line bundle $\mathcal{O}_{\widetilde{Y}}(-r\widetilde{E})|_{\widetilde{E}}$.

(4) The log Fano pair underlying $E$ is K-polystable.

(5) Consequently, every symplectic singularity $x \in X$ admits a Kollár component which is a contact Fano variety in the orbifold sense.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture is stated as an open problem about the structure of normalized-volume minimizers for symplectic singularities. While related rank-one minimizer results and K-semistability/Kollár component theory have been developed (e.g. by Li–Xu, Liu–Xu, Zhuang and recent work on canonical torus actions on symplectic singularities), no source found establishes all five parts (Kollár-component minimizer, log discrepancy $rn$ with $r\in\{1,2\}$, orbifold contact structure from the residue, K-polystability, and contact-Fano realization) for every symplectic singularity. The problem appears to be open.

status_evidence.title: Canonical torus action on symplectic singularities
status_evidence.snippet: A log Q-Fano pair comes with a singular contact structure or contact orbifold structure...
status_evidence.claim: Recent work investigates contact orbifold structures on log Q-Fano pairs from symplectic singularities, but the full conjecture is not resolved.

status_evidence.title: Uniqueness of the minimizer of the normalized volume function
status_evidence.snippet: A divisorial valuation minimizes the normalized volume if and only if it is a K-semistable Kollár component.
status_evidence.claim: The general theory linking normalized-volume minimizers to Kollár components is known, but the specific symplectic-singularity statements (rn weight, contact structure, K-polystability) remain conjectural.

status_evidence.title: On boundedness of singularities and minimal log discrepancies of Kollár components, II
status_evidence.snippet: Boundedness of K-semistable log Fano cone singularities is studied via Kollár components.
status_evidence.claim: Related boundedness conjectures are addressed, but the structural conjecture for symplectic singularities is not proved here.
